note: Both sets correctly capture the two annotated figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336°) and the doubling relation of Eq. (7-17), and both share the same flaws: invented quotes such as "Original Data point at x=0/x=23", axis-label-only quotes used to support numeric estimates, a wrong "-90E6 at last data point" (the last point near 23° is about -120E6), and a misbound "blade-pitch controller" entity for the θK definition. Set B adds one clear misbinding that Set A avoids: it labels θK as the "intercept" of the best-fit line, whereas the text states the intercept is the second bracketed term and θK is the pitch angle where sensitivity has doubled. Set A's only extra weak item is an unsupported graph estimate (-100E+6 at 17.5°), so A is marginally more faithful.
